title: node9 - Execution security layer for AI agents (intercepts every tool call, DLP scanner, AI negotiation loop, flight recorder, shadow undo)
verdict: Extract DLP regex patterns as a PreToolUse hook now; defer binary adoption until source is auditable
key_insight: Three patterns not found elsewhere in catalogue: multi-channel approval racing (fire all channels simultaneously, first response wins), AI negotiation loop on block (structured explanation + safer path suggestion), and shadow undo (silent git snapshot before every AI file write). The DLP scanner covering AWS/GitHub/Stripe/PEM is always-on with zero config — the right default for --dangerously-skip-permissions environments.

Shadow Undo — silent git snapshot before every AI file edit; node9 undo --steps N to roll back
